gloss: food poisoning; upset stomach from food

definitions.gloss: food poisoning; upset stomach caused by food
definitions.explanation: illness caused by eating contaminated or spoiled food, typically resulting in stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhea

examples.japanese: {食|しょく}あたり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
{生|なま}もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{食|しょく}あたりになった。
examples.english: I got food poisoning from eating raw food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|しょく}あたり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You have to be careful of food poisoning in summer.

notes:
{食|しょく}あたり refers to illness from eating contaminated or spoiled food. It is an everyday term used in casual and general contexts, as opposed to the more formal medical term ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食|しょく}あたり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get food poisoning
- {食|しょく}あたり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to come down with food poisoning
- {食|しょく}あたり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる: not used — the verb あたる is already in the word

SYMPTOMS:
Common symptoms include ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧ (nausea), ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧ (stomach pain), and ⟦{下痢|げり}→下痢：05382_geri⟧ (diarrhea).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧: food poisoning (formal/medical; used in news reports and official contexts)
- {食|しょく}あたり: food poisoning (everyday; used in casual conversation)

PREVENTION:
⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧ (summertime) is when {食|しょく}あたり is most common due to heat and humidity.
